title: Signed-equivalence ledger for the 30 discovered S8 identity octets
method: Assign one deterministic, solver-selected Garden signing to each discovered identity octet solely as an orbit representative.
Classify the 30 representatives under four explicitly separated signed equivalence relations.
Serialize boson, fermion, color, node-switch, supercharge-sign, and level-duality maps for every class membership.
Verify every witness directly against all 64 colored edges and reject a deliberately mutated witness.
Compute the GF(2) rank of the 24 node-switch and supercharge-sign generators on every support and compare it with the exact Garden nullity.
Use right-translation covariance to extend the identity-support classification to every translated hyperedge without enumerating labeled signings.

equivalence_layers.name: fixed-color-nodal
equivalence_layers.interpretation: signed boson and fermion node permutations with all eight color labels fixed

equivalence_layers.name: fixed-color-nodal-plus-supercharge-signs
equivalence_layers.interpretation: fixed-color nodal equivalence enlarged by independent signs on the eight supercharges

equivalence_layers.name: unlabeled-color-signed-graph
equivalence_layers.interpretation: nodal equivalence, supercharge signs, and all permutations of the eight colors

equivalence_layers.name: unlabeled-color-signed-graph-plus-duality
equivalence_layers.interpretation: the preceding quotient enlarged by interchange of boson and fermion levels

findings: The four equivalence layers contain 30, 30, 1, 1 classes respectively.
After color relabeling and supercharge signs are admitted, all 30 discovered identity representatives lie in one signed graph class.
Boson-fermion level duality does not merge anything further in this finite ledger.
On every support the gauge-action rank is 19, exactly equal to the Garden nullity, so node switches and supercharge signs act transitively on all 2^19 signings.
Right-translation covariance therefore places all 79272345600 labeled signings across the 151,200 hyperedges in one unlabeled-color signed graph class.
The solver-selected sign masks are recorded for reproducibility but are not used as invariants or class identifiers.
boundary: This ledger classifies the full affine Garden-signing spaces by an exact gauge-rank argument, without enumerating them. The single-class result is scoped to unlabeled colors, signed node relabelings, supercharge signs, and optional boson-fermion duality. It does not identify that one-dimensional quotient with four-dimensional physical equivalence, enhancement, or parentage.
